Our Journey

Born Under the Moon

Established in 2023, Moon' Coffee started as a peaceful nocturnal sanctuary in Lipa City where coffee lovers could gather late into the night. With our rocky lunar theme and warm hospitality, we expanded to our second home — Moon Coffee 2.0.

✨ Artisanal Brews
